article.hook: Someone is expanding their map so wide it tears. Pluto in Sagittarius pushes the urge to rewrite the rules of what freedom means - until the stretch snaps into obsession.
article.lived: For about two decades, this transit shows itself in how we chase big ideas and bigger truths. We see it when a conversation about beliefs turns into a battle for who owns reality, or when a personal quest for meaning becomes a crusade that bulldozes nuance. The urge to transform how we see the world drives people to cross borders - literal and mental - until the horizon feels like a line to run through, not a place to rest.
article.turn: The gift flips when the hunger for expansion becomes a need to control the story, turning optimism into a rigid doctrine. You watch people double down on their version of truth, cutting off anyone who questions the map they’re building. Power becomes a weapon to enforce belief, not to explore it.
moves: Challenge one big belief you’ve held as absolute this week.
Join a conversation with someone who sees the world wildly different than you do and listen without planning a rebuttal.
Start a project that requires learning something completely outside your usual interests.
